title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Singh
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstart docs for the public docs site. Motivation: provide opinionated starter kits for customers who want to combine retrieval with agents/tool-calling patterns. This PR contains: 1) three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, docs-assistant, ticket-triage) with accompanying config and sample datasets, 2) tool-calling examples demonstrating a search + actions flow (search API, knowledge connectors, and external REST tool integration), 3) docs site pages and quickstarts with runnable code snippets (Python/TS) and a walkthrough, 4) small updates to the examples CLI to scaffold RAG projects. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and sample prompts - [x] Add Python and TypeScript quickstart examples - [x] Update docs site nav and metadata - [x] Add unit tests for example scaffolding - [x] Add CI docs-preview job - [x] Add release notes entry Related work: ENG-7123 (RAG quickstarts), PM-341 (docs prioritization). This is scoped as docs/examples only; no runtime changes. See commits and changed files for details.
